archetype: Custom E-commerce (Amazon-inspired with Swiss High-Contrast structure)

rules: No Inter for headings. Use Outfit.
Uppercase tight tracking for labels and overlines.
Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for text.

grid.product_grid: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 xl:grid-cols-5 gap-6

navigation.style: Dark background (#232F3E) with white text, sticky top (z-50).
navigation.elements: Logo, wide search bar with category dropdown, user profile, cart with badge.
navigation.search_bar: White background, rounded-md, orange search button.
navigation.mobile: Hamburger menu on left, full-screen drawer for categories.

hero_carousel.style: Full width or large container, generous height (max 80vh), smooth slide animation.
hero_carousel.content: Large promotional graphics, clear CTA button.
hero_carousel.overlay: bg-gradient-to-r from-black/60 to-transparent for text readability.

product_card.layout: Vertical stack. Image at top (aspect-square, object-contain, bg-white), details below.
product_card.details: Product title (truncate 2 lines), star rating, price (large, bold), discount badge, 'Add to Cart' button (primary color).
product_card.hover: Slight upward translation (-translate-y-1) and enhanced shadow.

shopping_cart.layout: Two-column on desktop (cart items on left, order summary on right).
shopping_cart.items: Horizontal layout, image, title, quantity selector (Shadcn Select or custom +/-, small size), delete button.
shopping_cart.summary: Sticky right column with subtotal, shipping info, and large checkout button.

checkout.layout: Clean, minimal interface without main nav distractions.
checkout.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select. Left-aligned labels, clear error states.
checkout.steps: Accordion or step-by-step wizard (Shipping -> Payment -> Review).

admin_dashboard.layout: Sidebar navigation (dark mode) + main content area (light mode).
admin_dashboard.widgets: Bento grid for top-level stats (Sales, Orders, Users).
admin_dashboard.tables: Shadcn Table for products and orders, with pagination and filtering.

toast_notifications.style: Clean white background, subtle border, colored icons based on status.

interactive_and_motion.hover_states: Buttons darken on hover (bg-primary to hover:bg-primary-hover). Links get underline or color shift.
interactive_and_motion.transitions: transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out for interactive elements.
interactive_and_motion.loading: Skeleton loaders for product grids and dashboard widgets.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Strict APCA/WCAG AA compliance. Orange on white must have dark text.
accessibility_and_testing.aria: Use aria-labels for icon-only buttons (cart, search).
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='add-to-cart-button').

image_urls.description: Two smiling women with shopping bags

icon_strategy.usage: Use for navigation, cart, user profile, settings, and standard UI elements. Keep stroke width consistent (1.5 or 2).

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Do not use generic blue defaults.
Ensure the hero carousel uses the provided images with proper gradient overlays for text readability.
Implement product cards with the hover effects detailed above.
Do NOT use placeholder images (like via.placeholder.com). Use the provided media URLs.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, and forms for testing purposes.
For the dashboard, strictly adhere to the bento grid layout.
